claim: The primary SSRF defense is implemented in the EPP/scheduler, not the sidecar: PR #244 clears any client-supplied prefill-target header to empty on ingress before the EPP sets its own value post-scheduling, because the Gateway API Inference Extension's ext_proc integration (GIE) only supports set_headers mutations, not remove_headers.
stance_target: gap-3: where the real security boundary lives and its portability to non-k8s deployments
scope_conditions: PR #244, merged 2025-07-16, llm-d-router (EPP-adjacent code, not the sidecar)
quoted_support: This sets the prefill target header to an empty string value ... A possibly better fix would have been to respond to the gateway (Envoy) with remove_headers mutation but GIE currently supports only set_headers mutations, so clearing the user provided values seems like the best option given the available functionality.
